scope: Same product with an option named several times in one message («1 sopa de ajiaco y 1 sopa de menudencias», «1 jugo pequeño de mora y 1 jugo pequeño de lulo», «2 malteadas de fresa y 1 malteada de vainilla»)
trigger: Gap found in batch 41: explicit counts for the same product with different options kept a single line
baselineFindings: «1 sopa de ajiaco y 1 sopa de menudencias» (one «Sopa» product with an option) added only Ajiaco, with the agent on or off: the segment fell to the scored-search path, which silently skipped a product already used

«1 jugo pequeño de mora y 1 jugo pequeño de lulo» added only Lulo; once both lines were kept, the standalone-drink path picked «Jugo» over «Jugo pequeño» because both fit and the preference rank favored the plain drink
«2 malteadas de fresa y 1 malteada de vainilla» stored 2 + 1 but replied «Malteada ×2 (Fresa), Malteada ×2 (Vainilla)»: the label took the quantity of the first cart line with that name
fix: resolveMultiProductOrderCore: one helper (alreadyUsed) replaces every silent «product already used» skip in the segment loop; a repeated product is kept when the segment states a different value for an option already stated on an earlier line (the rule the embedded path already had). resolveStandaloneDrinkOrder prefers the longest drink name actually said («jugo pequeño» → Jugo pequeño). buildCartAddReply takes the quantity of each repeated label from its own cart line when the label has no explicit quantity.
